title: 2023 Panini Prizm #63 Tyler Boyd Cincinnati Bengals Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2023 Panini Prizm trading card featuring Tyler Boyd from the Cincinnati Bengals. It's a standard size card with a thickness of 35 Pt. The card is an original and features Boyd in the base set. The card number is 63 and it's part of the 2023 season. The card is in English and is manufactured by Panini in the United States. The set is a Prizm parallel/variety. The card is not autographed and has no authentication. It's perfect for any collector or fan of the sport.
